def probe(r,c,label):
    before = current_frame.ascii
    action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':r,'col':c}])
    cur = current_frame.ascii
    diffs = [(rr,cc,before.split('\n')[rr][cc],cur.split('\n')[rr][cc]) for rr in range(64) for cc in range(64) if before.split('\n')[rr][cc]!=cur.split('\n')[rr][cc]]
    d2 = [d for d in diffs if d[0]<63]
    print(label, 'gameplay diffs:', d2[:20])

probe(3,43,'click topbar purple box')
